description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 01.08.2022 to 07.08.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The notification is issued by the Director General of Customs in an official regulatory capacity, not as a government personnel or structural change.
